title: Registry for pertrochanteric hip disorders (GTPS)
summary:
The so-called Greater Trochanteric Pain Syndrome (GTPS) includes many symptoms and manifestations, pain and limitations in walking in different forms.
We would like to include all our patients with these complaints in a registry to document the treatment methods and the results.
The purpose of this registry is to increase data and thus knowledge about the syndrome in order to evaluate and adjust treatment methods.
Study patients will be invited to follow-up appointments at 3 months, 1 and 2 years according to orthopedic routine. 
Patients will be asked to complete questionnaires, strength measurements, and sonography will be performed.

interventions.name: Patients with pertrochanteric symptoms of different causes will be prospectively included in this registry study. The aim is to analyze the different conversational and surgical therapy approaches to improve the therapy regime of the disease GTPS.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with pertrochanteric complaints of various causes before and after therapy.
Exclusion criteria:
Patient request
